assets.name: food-enrichment
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated pixel-art game sprite for a personal virtual dog shelter UI, legible at about 100 px. Style: crisp chunky pixel clusters, hard dark brown outlines, limited warm cream and light brown palette with muted blue accents. Match the friendly detailed front three-quarter Swedish pixel shelter illustration already inspected: clean stepped edges, small highlights and 16-bit game-object character, not vector art, not smooth 3D. Composition: single compact cohesive station centered, fully contained in a square canvas with modest transparent padding, front three-quarter view. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with real alpha. No floor tile, no room, no scenery, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside the objects, no dog, no person, no labels, no text, no watermark. Subject: a friendly low wooden feeding station containing a small kibble bowl, a water bowl, a cream food sack with a simple brown paw icon (no lettering), a small ball and a knotted rope toy. Kibble bowl and toys are clearly visible at the front. The food sack sits behind the bowls. Keep forms bold and readable rather than many tiny decorations.
